icon: Keep it. The rival icons are orange plate with a fork, green leaf on white, red cooking pot; none uses a jar, so the green jar already stands apart in search results. Don't test it in the same round as the screenshots.

store_test.what: The new screenshot set against the current one. Icon unchanged. The preview is added after this test ends, so it doesn't take the first search slot and hide the screenshot result.
store_test.where: App Store: 1,840 ratings against 960 on Google Play (a proxy; no traffic numbers were given)
store_test.settings: Product page optimization, one treatment against the original, iOS 15 or later; don't release a version that changes these screenshots while it runs
store_test.decision_rule: Apply the new set if App Store Connect reports it performs better. On a draw, apply it anyway, because it fixes a flagged problem: frame 1 shows no app interface today.
store_test.after: Then run a Google Play default graphics experiment with one variant (screenshots), target metric unique user install clicks.
